title: WebGPU Text Overlay in Rust and wgpu
description: Render text over a 3D scene with Rust and wgpu. Learn glyph atlases, bundled fonts, Unicode and RTL shaping, dynamic FPS labels, and WebGPU overlay passes.
imageAlt: A cube with smoothly blended vertex colors on a dark background, with white GPU and FPS text at the upper left and blue Persian text at the lower right.
